title: Cosmology and particle physics bridge
prerequisites: G7a, P8, M5, M7; G7b useful.
purpose: Connect cosmological models to observations and understand where particle physics enters early universe predictions.
primary_reading: Perimeter PSI Online course collection — Select the Theoretical Mechanics, Statistical Physics or Cosmology module matching this course. Use the module notes and exercises by topic.

blocks.deliverable: Define scale factor, redshift and distance conventions.
Derive a simple matter or radiation dominated solution.
Estimate an epoch using temperature and expansion scales.
Week 7 midterm; distinguish background from perturbations.
Compare predictions and degeneracies without overclaiming detection.
Explain which assumptions connect a model to an observable.
Report parameters and uncertainty and take a cosmology final.

project: Solve a simple expansion history numerically and compare an observable with a stated benchmark.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
